capabilities: Create and edit multi-sheet workbooks in an Excel-like interface
Compute formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP and more) with cross-sheet references
Format cells with number formats, fonts, colors, borders, merges and freeze panes
Embed Obsidian notes as linked content inside cells
disambiguation: Not a Microsoft Excel product; workbooks are stored as plain Markdown files with JSON data blocks, not .xlsx.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual via release download or building from source.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spreadsheet editing, so users must manage Excel or CSV files outside the vault.
summary: Spreadsheet editor that creates and edits Excel-like multi-sheet workbooks with formulas, stored as Markdown files, powered by Univer.
